archetypes.name: env-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends on a narrow routing envelope and strict session-env ownership across the Step 0 boundary.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed wrapper envelope contains every key consumed before the first session-env rehydration and no plan step assumes keys that will no longer be exported inline. Check the initial and resume paths separately, especially IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR discovery, dirty-tree resume re-parse, degraded-tools presence keys, and the NEVER #14 boundary around session-env.sh. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: operator-redaction
archetypes.rationale: Exit-2 handling moves sensitive operator-message and redaction behavior into a new wrapper.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for gaps in preserving the exact STEP_FAILED operator behavior when moving the exit-2 handler out of SKILL.md. Pay special attention to copy-plan and gh-issue-view stderr log handling, redact-secrets.sh and redact-tmpdir-paths.sh ordering, stdout versus stderr expectations, and missing-tmpdir tolerance. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sync-surface
archetypes.rationale: This refactor touches generated-style prompt prose, script contracts, harness pins, and documentation that can easily drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit whether the plan names the full edit-in-sync surface for extracting Step 0 bootstrap invocation into scripts/implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh. Look for missing contract sibling updates, stale structural pins, Makefile shard omissions, script-md-sibling expectations, and cross-document wording that could still describe the removed inline helper or phantom schema-loading behavior. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
